mechanism_narrative: RETAIL_REC has stabilized near -88 after an initial crash; the last 28-day mean is dragged down by the transition from normal to lockdown, so the next 28-day mean will be higher as mobility remains at a low but stable level.
evidence_refs: fact:last-4-week mean is -88.05 while most recent week is -88.0
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is lower than over the last 28 days despite stabilization of recent weekly values.

mechanism_narrative: If TRANSIT falls below -85, it indicates that lockdown compliance is deepening, which will further suppress retail footfall and drive RETAIL_REC lower over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT falls below -85 percent change from baseline
failure_condition: TRANSIT falls below -85 but RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days is higher than over the previous 14 days.

mechanism_narrative: The joint signal of deeply negative WORKPLACES and highly positive RESIDENTIAL indicates a home-confinement regime that suppresses discretionary retail; as this pattern persists, RETAIL_REC will remain below its last 28-day mean.
failure_condition: WORKPLACES remains below -70 and RESIDENTIAL above 30, yet RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days exceeds its last 28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: In a strict lockdown regime, GROCERY_PHARM is the only retail category with relatively less decline; as long as GROCERY_PHARM remains below -40, it signals that only essential shopping is occurring, keeping RETAIL_REC suppressed.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM below -40 percent change from baseline
failure_condition: GROCERY_PHARM remains below -40 but RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is higher than over the last 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: The extreme suppression of PARKS indicates outdoor activity is severely restricted; as people adapt to lockdown, a slight increase in outdoor activity will coincide with a marginal rise in RETAIL_REC over the next week.
candidate_trigger: PARKS rises above -75 percent change from baseline
failure_condition: PARKS rises above -75 but RETAIL_REC over the next 7 days is lower than over the previous 7 days.

mechanism_narrative: Seasonal autumn decline in retail activity from March to April is small but negative; because the lockdown effect dominates, RETAIL_REC will be lower over the next 28 days than over the last 28 days which included pre-lockdown seasonal strength.
evidence_refs: fact:April is typically lower retail than March in Melbourne
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is higher than over the last 28 days despite seasonal expectations.

mechanism_narrative: Stage 3 lockdown restrictions in Victoria will continue for at least the next four weeks, keeping both WORKPLACES and TRANSIT deeply negative; this policy stringency will drive RETAIL_REC lower over the next 28 days compared to the last 28 days which included a pre-lockdown period.
evidence_refs: fact:Victoria Stage 3 lockdown effective from 30 March 2020
failure_condition: Restrictions ease within four weeks and RETAIL_REC rises above its last 28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: When GROCERY_PHARM is only moderately negative while RETAIL_REC is extremely negative, the gap indicates suppressed discretionary shopping; as grocery/pharmacy mobility stabilizes, the gap will narrow and RETAIL_REC will rise slightly.
failure_condition: GROCERY_PHARM remains below -45 and RETAIL_REC below -85, yet RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days is lower than over the previous 14 days.
